Company Background: Hualien County is located in eastern Taiwan and is known for its pure mountains, ocean resources, and diverse cultures. Local farmer's groups and young farmers develop value-added items like tea gift sets, rice snacks, grain drinks, and local specialty foods. In recent years, Hualien has also linked agriculture with tribal experiences, food tourism, and culture, adding stories and value to local products. To help local products reach more markets, the Hualien County Government joins key food shows to connect with buyers and promote the county's clean, diverse farm products to show healthy, natural products like grains, teas, indigenous snacks, and local coffee. The goal is to expand sales, find new buyers, and share Hualien's pure and trusted products with the world.

Company Background: Sichuan Shengxiang Rose Ecological Agriculture Development Co., Ltd., founded in 2013 with RMB 100 million registered capital, is located in the 4A-level Zhanglan Hometown Scenic Area in Xichong County. It operates a 3,000-mu (200-hectare) organic rose demonstration base and is China's only rose product manufacturer with organic certifications from China, EU, Japan, and the US, and also holds the "National Famous, Special, and Excellent New Agricultural Products" title. The company is a National High-Tech Enterprise, an IP Utilization Pilot Enterprise (MIIT), a Sichuan "Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative" firm, a leading forestry-grassland industrialization enterprise, and a high-quality agricultural trade development base. Its "Meilan" brand is listed in the Sichuan Agricultural Brand Catalog. Its products have won the "Tianfu Granary·Sichuan Expo Most Popular Product" and "Houji Award" honors, and it owns 49 national patents. Meilan offers four core product lines with over 20 items, including organic rose tea, skincare, rose jam, and wellness series, aiming to become the benchmark brand in China's organic rose industry.
